name: 1K
source:
"1K" is an omnibus boys love visual novel with the theme of two people living in one room. There are five different episodes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
